lesson: Adding and Subtracting Fractions Using the LCM

questions.statement: Your teacher has asked you to find the LCM of 3 and 10. Which is easier?

options.A: List the multiples of 3 until you find a multiple of 10
options.B: List the multiples of 10 until you find a multiple of 3

questions.statement: Fill in the blanks by listing the multiples of 10 (not including 0) until you find a multiple of 3. Then complete the statement below.

exercises.question: The lowest common multiple (LCM) of 3 and 10 is [x]
